title: Shah Rukh Khan, Deepika Padukone to Shoot King Song in Mumbai October 26
excerpt: The grand song, choreographed by Vaibhavi Merchant, will be filmed over a week in Mumbai for Siddharth Anand's King, the pair's sixth film together, due Christmas 2026.
body:
• Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone will shoot a grand song for King in Mumbai starting October 26, choreographed by Vaibhavi Merchant, according to Variety India reporting carried by NDTV and Bollywood Hungama.
  • The song is expected to feature the film's cast and will be filmed over about a week in Mumbai, after earlier reports suggested the sequence might be shot in South Africa.
  • King is the pair's sixth film together, after Om Shanti Om, Chennai Express, Happy New Year, Pathaan and Jawan, and Merchant's eighth collaboration with Shah Rukh Khan.
  • Directed and co-written by Siddharth Anand and co-starring Suhana Khan, the action entertainer is scheduled for the Christmas 2026 cinema window.

Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone are set to reunite on the sets of King for a grand song sequence to be filmed in Mumbai from October 26, according to a report by Variety India carried by NDTV and Bollywood Hungama. The song is expected to feature the film's cast, with choreographer Vaibhavi Merchant overseeing the sequence, and preparations are already underway.

A week in Mumbai, not South Africa

The song will be filmed over the course of about a week in Mumbai, Bollywood Hungama reported. Earlier reports had suggested the team might travel to South Africa to shoot the sequence; the latest update says the makers have decided to film it in the city instead, with extensive arrangements being made ahead of the shoot. Variety India, which first reported the schedule, described it as a mega song sequence expected to feature the entire cast.

"The song is expected to feature the film's cast, with choreographer Vaibhavi Merchant overseeing the sequence, and preparations are already underway."

The schedule will mark Vaibhavi Merchant's eighth collaboration with Shah Rukh Khan; the choreographer last worked with him on Jawan. Bollywood Hungama also reported the Mumbai schedule will mark Padukone's return to the sets after she welcomed her second daughter, Devi Padukone Singh, with husband Ranveer Singh.

Sixth film for a defining pairing

King will be the sixth on-screen collaboration between Shah Rukh Khan and Deepika Padukone. Padukone made her Hindi film debut opposite him in Farah Khan's Om Shanti Om in 2007. They reunited in Rohit Shetty's Chennai Express in 2013 and Happy New Year in 2014, then shared screen space again in Siddharth Anand's Pathaan in 2023 and in Jawan the same year — two of that year's biggest Hindi releases. That run, from a debut launch to consecutive blockbusters nearly two decades later, is why a single song schedule on their next film draws this level of attention.

What King is

King is an action entertainer directed and co-written by Siddharth Anand, who also directed Pathaan. The ensemble cast, as reported by Bollywood Hungama, comprises Shah Rukh Khan, Suhana Khan — his daughter, in a pivotal role — Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan, Anil Kapoor, Jackie Shroff, Rani Mukerji, Jaideep Ahlawat, Arshad Warsi and Raghav Juyal, with Abhay Verma also associated with the project. The film is backed by Gauri Khan, Siddharth Anand and Mamta Anand under Red Chillies Entertainment and Marflix Pictures.

The film is scheduled to arrive in cinemas during the Christmas 2026 window. Bollywood Hungama noted it will face competition in that window from major Hollywood releases including Jumanji, Avengers: Doomsday and Dune 3. For diaspora audiences, King is positioned as the big Hindi theatrical release of the holiday season — the SRK-Padukone pairing, an Anand action canvas and a Christmas slot that has historically been one of Bollywood's most contested. With the release approaching, the October 26 song shoot is among the final major production beats reported for the film, and the next updates to watch are any official first-look or music announcements from Red Chillies Entertainment.
